info.description: List verifications of a location, ordered by create time.
info.title: Google My Business API

requests.description: Lists all of the accounts for the authenticated user. This includes all accounts that the user owns, as well as any accounts for which the user has management rights.
requests.name: GET /v4/accounts

requests.description: Creates an account with the specified name and type under the given parent. - Personal accounts and Organizations cannot be created. - User Groups cannot be created with a Personal account as primary owner. - Location Groups cannot be created with a primary owner of a Personal account if the Personal account is in an Organization. - Location Groups cannot own Location Groups.
requests.name: POST /v4/accounts

requests.description: Returns the list of available attributes that would be available for a location with the given primary category and country.
requests.name: GET /v4/attributes

requests.description: Returns a list of business categories. Search will match the category name but not the category ID. *Note:* Search only matches the front of a category name (that is, 'food' may return 'Food Court' but not 'Fast Food Restaurant').
requests.name: GET /v4/categories

requests.description: Returns a list of business categories for the provided language and GConcept ids.
requests.name: GET /v4/categories:batchGet

requests.description: Searches the chain based on chain name.
requests.name: GET /v4/chains:search

requests.description: Sets the pubsub notification settings for the account informing Business Profile which topic to send pubsub notifications for: - New reviews for locations administered by the account. - Updated reviews for locations administered by the account. - New `GoogleUpdates` for locations administered by the account. An account will only have one notification settings resource, and only one pubsub topic can be set.
requests.name: PUT /v4/{name}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns insights for a set of local posts associated with a single listing. Which metrics and how they are reported are options specified in the request proto. *Note:* Insight reports are limited to 100 `local_post_names` per call.
requests.name: POST /v4/{name}/localPosts:reportInsights
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets all of the specified locations in the given account.
requests.name: POST /v4/{name}/locations:batchGet
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns the paginated list of reviews for all specified locations. This operation is only valid if the specified locations are verified. *Note:* Reviews are limited to a batch size of 200 `location_names` per call.
requests.name: POST /v4/{name}/locations:batchGetReviews
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns a report containing insights on one or more metrics by location. *Note:* Insight reports are limited to a batch size of 10 `location_names` per call.
requests.name: POST /v4/{name}/locations:reportInsights
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Deletes the response to the specified review. This operation is only valid if the specified location is verified.
requests.name: DELETE /v4/{name}/reply
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates the reply to the specified review. A reply is created if one does not exist. This operation is only valid if the specified location is verified.
requests.name: PUT /v4/{name}/reply
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Accepts the specified invitation.
requests.name: POST /v4/{name}:accept
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Associates a location to a place ID. Any previous association is overwritten. This operation is only valid if the location is unverified. The association must be valid, that is, it appears in the list of `FindMatchingLocations`.
requests.name: POST /v4/{name}:associate
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Clears an association between a location and its place ID. This operation is only valid if the location is unverified.
requests.name: POST /v4/{name}:clearAssociation
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Completes a `PENDING` verification. It is only necessary for non `AUTO` verification methods. `AUTO` verification request is instantly `VERIFIED` upon creation.
requests.name: POST /v4/{name}:complete

requests.description: Declines the specified invitation.
requests.name: POST /v4/{name}:decline
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Finds all of the possible locations that are a match to the specified location. This operation is only valid if the location is unverified.
requests.name: POST /v4/{name}:findMatches
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Generates an account number for this account. The account number is not provisioned when an account is created. Use this request to create an account number when it is required.
requests.name: POST /v4/{name}:generateAccountNumber
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns the Google updated Lodging of a specific location.
requests.name: GET /v4/{name}:getGoogleUpdated
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets the Google-updated version of the specified location. Returns `NOT_FOUND` if the location does not exist.
requests.name: GET /v4/{name}:googleUpdated
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: List all the GoogleLocations that have been recommended to the specified Business Profile account. Recommendations are provided for personal accounts and location groups only, requests for all other account types will result in an error. The recommendations for location groups are based on the locations in that group. The recommendations for personal accounts are based on all of the locations that the user has access to on Business Profile (which includes locations they can access through location groups), and is a superset of all recommendations generated for the user.
requests.name: GET /v4/{name}:recommendGoogleLocations
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Report a GoogleLocation.
requests.name: POST /v4/{name}:report
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Moves a location from an account that the user owns to another account that the same user administers. The user must be an owner of the account the location is currently associated with and must also be at least a manager of the destination account. Returns the Location with its new resource name.
requests.name: POST /v4/{name}:transfer
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
